title: Ballet Studio Reverie
description: In a whimsical blue ballet studio, a seated Black woman in a dark blue starry tutu holds a ballerina in mid-air arabesque. Another ballerina in a pink tutu lies dramatically on the wooden floor with an open book beside her. The walls are adorned with framed ballet illustrations, hanging paper lanterns, and dance memorabilia.
prompt: A surreal ballet studio scene with deep blue walls and wooden floors. A graceful Black woman in a dark blue starry tutu sits on a bench and holds a ballerina in a white tutu performing an arabesque above her. Another ballerina in a voluminous pink tutu lies on the floor with an open book nearby. The room is filled with framed ballet drawings, hanging blue paper lanterns, and dance memorabilia, in a detailed painterly style with magical realism.
